evals.prompt: Scaffold a new .NET 10 minimal API backend project. The solution is called Contoso.Reporting.
evals.expected_output: A complete .NET 10 Minimal API project scaffolded at src/Contoso.Reporting.Web/ with API versioning, Swagger, FluentValidation, health checks, CSP security-headers middleware, and a global error handler. No authentication.
assertions: Project files created under src/Contoso.Reporting.Web/ (default .Web suffix when none specified)
Program.cs configures AddApiVersioning with UrlSegmentApiVersionReader and HeaderApiVersionReader
Program.cs registers AddSwaggerGen and uses Swagger UI in Development
Program.cs registers FluentValidation via AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<Program>
Program.cs maps /health, /health/ready, and /health/live health check endpoints
Middleware/CSPOptions.cs and Middleware/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.cs created
Program.cs adds app.UseMiddleware<SecurityHeadersMiddleware>()
Program.cs contains a global UseExceptionHandler returning ProblemDetails
.csproj references Asp.Versioning.Http, FluentValidation, and Swashbuckle.AspNetCore
No authentication: no AddAuthentication, AddVeracity, AddJwtBearer, or .RequireAuthorization() in Program.cs
No Veracity packages referenced in .csproj (no Veracity.Common.OAuth.AspNetCore, no Veracity.Core.Api.V4)
appsettings.json contains the CSP section
launchSettings.json uses port 54438 (the skill's default) or a user-specified port — not a dynamically-generated dotnet template port
.csproj targets net10.0 with a UserSecretsId GUID
appsettings.json CSP section uses only generic 'self' sources (no Veracity CDN hostnames)

evals.prompt: Create a baseline .NET web API skeleton called PaymentsGateway with health checks and API versioning.
evals.expected_output: A project at src/PaymentsGateway.Web/ with the standard baseline (versioning, swagger, validation, health checks, security headers) and no auth.
assertions: Project files created under src/PaymentsGateway.Web/
Program.cs maps /health, /health/ready, /health/live
Program.cs configures AddApiVersioning with default ApiVersion 1.0
Versioned API group MapGroup("/api/v{version:apiVersion}") created without .RequireAuthorization()
Middleware/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.cs created and added to the pipeline
No authentication or Veracity packages referenced
.csproj targets net10.0 with a UserSecretsId

evals.prompt: I have an existing .NET 10 API at src/Acme.Orders.Api/. Add the standard baseline (api versioning, swagger, health checks, CSP/security headers) without touching my existing endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Baseline capabilities integrated into the existing project: packages added only if missing, middleware and config merged, existing endpoints preserved. No authentication added.
assertions: Integration mode used (existing Program.cs not wholesale replaced)
Middleware/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.cs and Middleware/CSPOptions.cs created
API versioning, Swagger, FluentValidation, and health checks added to Program.cs where missing
CSP section merged into appsettings without overwriting existing keys
Asp.Versioning / FluentValidation / Swashbuckle packages added only if not already present
No authentication, JWT bearer, or Veracity auth packages/services added
Existing endpoints preserved
Existing endpoints left in their original location (not moved/rewritten into the versioned apiGroup); a versioned apiGroup scaffold is still present for future endpoints
Baseline middleware inserted in the canonical order (UseExceptionHandler first, then Swagger in Development, UseHttpsRedirection, SecurityHeadersMiddleware, then health-check mappings)
Existing Properties/launchSettings.json not overwritten (only created if the project lacked one)
If the existing .csproj lacked a UserSecretsId, one is generated and added

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new .NET minimal API called Telemetry. Use HTTPS port 7200 for local development.
evals.expected_output: A project at src/Telemetry.Web/ with launchSettings.json using HTTPS port 7200 and the standard baseline.
assertions: Project files created under src/Telemetry.Web/
Properties/launchSettings.json applicationUrl uses https://localhost:7200
Standard baseline present (versioning, swagger, health checks, security headers)
No authentication added
